note: Adopted by the project owner without independent re-derivation; review below is assistant-authored (Opus 5). Implements the issue's own proposal, including its heuristic verbatim - `self.name.lower() in view.schema.lower()` is a substring match, so transforming a table named `dog` also drops and recreates any view whose SQL mentions `dogs` or `dogfood`. Defensible as a throwaway script (which is where the issue got it), weaker as library behaviour. Also: a view referencing a dropped column is recreated silently broken, since SQLite does not validate view bodies at CREATE time. Resolves the issue's open opt-in/opt-out question unilaterally toward opt-in, which is at least backwards compatible.
